name: usehourly-mcp

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The signed-in account (name, email, currency, business details printed on invoices) and what this token may do (read or write). Call this first to confirm the connection.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Every active project with its client and hourly rate. Use the "label" ("Client / Project") or the id wherever a project is asked for. Set include_archived to also see archived ones.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description: Active clients, each with its currency and its active projects. Rates are in the client's currency (its own, else the account's).

tools.name: get_client
tools.description: One client's billing details: full legal name and address as printed on invoices.

client.description: Client id or exact client name

tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: Time entries between two dates (inclusive), newest first, with totals per project and per day. Optionally limited to one project. Use this for 'what did I log last week' and to check a day before adding time.

project.description: Only this project: id or "Client / Project"

tools.name: project_totals
tools.description: Logged hours per project: all time and within a date range (for example this month).

from.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD

to.description: Last day of the range (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: get_running_timer
tools.description: The timer that is running now, with elapsed minutes, or null when none is running.

tools.name: annual_report
tools.description: One calendar year: hours and earnings by quarter, month, client and project, plus invoices issued and paid (cash and accrual views).

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Invoice history (newest 200 at most), each with the currency it was issued in. Filter by text, client, paid status or issue-date range. unpaid_totals has one figure per currency; unpaid_total is only set when every match is in one currency.

query.description: Matches number, client, notes, project names and entry notes

client.description: Only this client: id or exact name

status.description: Filter by whether the invoice has been paid

issued_from.description: Only invoices issued on or after this date

issued_to.description: Only invoices issued on or before this date

sort.description: newest/oldest by issue date, highest/lowest by total

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: The frozen invoice as issued: seller, client, lines per project and totals. Set include_detail for the per-entry breakdown. Logos are left out.

invoice.description: Invoice id or invoice number, e.g. INV-2026-004

include_detail.description: Include the per-entry breakdown under the lines

tools.name: next_invoice_number
tools.description: The suggested next invoice number for a year, such as INV-2026-004.

year.description: Year of the invoice issue date, e.g. 2026

tools.name: get_timesheet
tools.description: The timesheet for a date range as a grid: one row per project, hours per day, totals per project and per day, and the weekdays with nothing logged. Optionally for one client or one project. Use this to 'show me my timesheet for last week' or to check a sheet before sharing it. Days marked non-billable still count here.

client.description: Only this client: id or exact name

project.description: Only this project: id or "Client / Project"

tools.name: parse_duration
tools.description: Turn text like "1h30", "1:30" or "2.5" into whole minutes, the way UseHourly reads it.

text.description: The duration text to read, e.g. 1h30

tools.name: log_time
tools.description: Add one time entry: a project, a date, how long, and what was done. Give minutes or a duration text. This adds a new entry; it never merges with an existing one. Check list_entries first if the day may already be logged.

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

date.description: The day the work was done, YYYY-MM-DD

minutes.description: Whole minutes worked (use this or duration)

duration.description: Duration text such as "1h30" (use this or minutes)

tools.name: log_time_on_days
tools.description: Add the same entry (project, minutes, note) on up to 31 dates. Days that already have time for this project are skipped and reported unless skip_existing is false.

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

dates.description: The days to log, YYYY-MM-DD (1 to 31 dates)

minutes.description: Whole minutes per day (use this or duration)

duration.description: Duration text per day, such as "1h30" (use this or minutes)

skip_existing.description: Skip days that already have time for this project (default true)

annotations.title: Log the same time on several days

tools.name: set_day_totals
tools.description: Set one project's total minutes for up to 31 days: more than 0 creates or updates that day's single entry, 0 clears it. Days that hold several entries or a running timer are skipped and reported, never merged. A note, when given, is applied to every day written.

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

minutes.description: Total minutes for that day; 0 clears it

cells.description: One item per day to set (1 to 31 days)

note.description: Description applied to every day written

annotations.title: Set a project's total for days

tools.name: update_entry
tools.description: Change an entry's project, date, minutes or note. Only the fields you pass change.

project.description: Move the entry to this project: id or "Client / Project"

date.description: Move the entry to this day, YYYY-MM-DD

minutes.description: New whole minutes (use this or duration)

duration.description: New duration text such as "1h30" (use this or minutes)

tools.name: merge_entries
tools.description: Fold several entries (same project, same day) into the first one: minutes are added and notes joined. The others are removed.

ids.description: Ids of the entries to merge; the first one is kept (2 to 20, same project and day)

tools.name: delete_entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one time entry. Confirm with the user before calling this.

tools.name: start_timer
tools.description: Start a timer on a project. A timer that is already running is stopped first, so only one runs at a time.

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

date.description: The day the timer starts on, YYYY-MM-DD

note.description: What is being worked on (max 2,000 characters)

tools.name: stop_timer
tools.description: Stop the running timer. Elapsed time is rounded up to the next minute (at least 1).

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Add a client. Names are unique per account.

name.description: The client's name (unique per account, max 80 characters)

tools.name: update_client
tools.description: Rename a client or change the legal name and address printed on its invoices. Only the fields you pass change; the logo is kept.

client.description: Client id or exact client name

tools.name: archive_client
tools.description: Hide a client from the lists. Its time and invoices are kept.

client.description: Client id or exact client name

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Add a project under a client, with an hourly rate in the client's currency (its own, else the account's) and whether it is billable.

client.description: Client id or exact client name

hourly_rate.description: Amount per hour in the client's currency (its own, else the account's), e.g. 85 or 62.5 (default 0)

billable.description: Whether the time goes on invoices (default true)

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Rename a project, move it to another client, or change its rate or billable flag. Only the fields you pass change.

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

client.description: Move the project to this client

hourly_rate.description: New amount per hour in the client's currency (its own, else the account's), e.g. 85 or 62.5

billable.description: Whether the time goes on invoices

tools.name: archive_project
tools.description: Hide a project from the lists. Its time and invoices are kept.

project.description: Project id, or "Client / Project" (just the project name works when it is unique)

tools.name: unarchive_project
tools.description: Bring an archived project (and its client, if archived) back.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Issue an invoice for a client from billable time between two dates. Totals are computed on the server from the logged entries (one line per project). The number defaults to the next INV-<year>-NNN. This creates a permanent record; confirm the client, period and dates with the user first.

client.description: Client id or exact client name

from.description: First day of the billed period

to.description: Last day of the billed period

due_date.description: Payment due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null for none

number.description: Invoice number; defaults to the next INV-<year>-NNN

notes.description: Notes printed on the invoice (max 1,000 characters)

include_detail.description: Print each entry under the lines

compact_notes.description: Shorten entry descriptions to about 100 characters

tools.name: mark_invoice_paid
tools.description: Record the date an invoice was paid (this matters for cash-basis taxes), or pass null to mark it unpaid again.

invoice.description: Invoice id or invoice number, e.g. INV-2026-004

annotations.title: Mark an invoice paid or unpaid

tools.name: delete_invoice
tools.description: Permanently delete an invoice record. The time entries stay. Confirm with the user before calling this.

invoice.description: Invoice id or invoice number, e.g. INV-2026-004

tools.name: share_timesheet
tools.description: Freeze the hours of a date range (optionally one client or project) into a private link a client can open without an account, read, print and approve. The link shows hours and, unless include_notes is false, the work descriptions; never rates or amounts. Anyone with the link can read it until it expires, so confirm the range, the client and whether to include notes with the user before calling. The link is returned only once: pass it on to the user. Not available on demo accounts.

client.description: Only this client: id or exact name

project.description: Only this project: id or "Client / Project"

include_notes.description: Show the work descriptions to the client (default true)

expires_in_days.description: How long the link works: 7, 30, 90 days (default 30)

title.description: A heading for the sheet (default: client and dates)

annotations.title: Create a timesheet link for a client

instructions: UseHourly tracks a freelancer's time. Time is whole minutes; dates are local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD). The server runs in UTC and does not know the user's today: always pass the date you mean. Name projects as "Client / Project" or by id (list_projects shows both). Money is in the account currency (whole units like 85 or 62.5, not cents; whoami says which currency). Before adding time, check list_entries for that day so nothing is logged twice. Ask the user before destructive actions (delete_entry, delete_invoice, merge_entries) and before create_invoice.
